final_rationale: The verdict does not change. The Actor did not provide genuinely new admissible evidence; the response narrows the claim and concedes the core missing predicate. That reframing is directionally more careful, but it is still a reinterpretation of the same record, not evidence that the current release documentation already reflects the required disclosure or that an approved mitigation or risk-acceptance record exists. Under the stated policy, aggregate readiness, no severity-one rehearsal incidents, prior family approval, and general public governance guidance can support launch context, but they cannot override the missing current-release model-card compliance condition. A caveated certification theory could become supportable if current-release disclosure were actually attached before launch, but on the present record that condition is unmet, so the release remains noncompliant rather than compliant_with_caveats.
